name: cto-patched
install_doc: Exactly the cto arm's installation, then three of the twelve hooks are replaced with the copies in hooks/: pre-tool-read-guard.sh, pre-tool-bash-guard.sh and post-write-token-diff.sh.
notes: PATCHED BY THE BENCHMARK, NOT SHIPPED BY THE VENDOR. The only change is where tool_name comes from: the stdin JSON Claude Code actually sends, falling back to nothing when it is absent, instead of $CLAUDE_TOOL_NAME, which Claude Code does not set. Thresholds and blocking logic are untouched. These are the same three files the 2026-09-03 ledger campaign used (bench/ledger/competitors/cto-patched); a fresh `cto hooks install --all` at 2.3.20 is byte-identical to that campaign's unpatched scaffold, so the patch still applies to the current release. Reported alongside the as-shipped arm, so the gap between the two is the cost of the vendor bug.
